verdict.rationale: Trivy's official MCP server (trivy-mcp) enables natural-language scanning, letting AI agents query and explain scan findings, which supports the 'explaining' part of the story. However, there is no evidence of deduplication logic or automated false-positive flagging features. missing for 10: explicit deduplication of findings, false-positive flagging/triage logic, and independent hands-on evidence of AI-driven triage quality.
